requirements.gap: No free unauthenticated complete input for fixed periods acquired. Paid API, keyed free API, and unresolved public archive access are distinct conditions.
Need dated full candidate membership, delistings and stable security identifiers. Do not construct past membership from current survivors.
Need causally known effective events and consistent price adjustment basis across previous close and current open, not an unproven corporate_actions_verified flag.
Need historical regular sessions, short days, extraordinary closures, halts, DST and prior regular close; exclude extended hours from opening range.
Short entries require historical borrow_cost_evidence and borrow_bps. No silent long-only restriction or zero borrow cost.
Frozen fee assumptions may support labelled candle analysis after data validation, not confirmed liquidity or fills. No new cost or risk rules introduced.

reentry_condition: New verified historical bundle, accessible anonymous archive, or separately authorized credentialed market-data access with unchanged research contract; do not repeat unchanged documentation probes.
